annotations.title: AI-training job market data for investors

description: Hiring radar, AITraining.jobs's dataset for investors: every AI-training role on the platforms' own job boards (Mercor, micro1, Appen, TELUS, Invisible and more) since its first read, one row per role with advertised pay, field, countries and open and close dates, plus each platform by day and a change log. Returns what it covers today, its files, who uses it, the price and how to get a sample.
